args.tcl:
# Ibex Synthesis for dc_shell
set design_dir "/home/EDA/ibex_demo"

# Create directories
file mkdir ${design_dir}/result/syn/data
file mkdir ${design_dir}/result/syn/report
file mkdir ${design_dir}/result/syn/work

# Setup libraries
set_app_var target_library "${design_dir}/designs/sky130hd/pdk/lib/sky130_fd_sc_hd__tt_025C_1v80.db"
set_app_var link_library "* ${design_dir}/designs/sky130hd/pdk/lib/sky130_fd_sc_hd__tt_025C_1v80.db"

# Set search path
set_app_var search_path "${design_dir}/designs/src/ibex"

# Read RTL files
analyze -format verilog [glob ${design_dir}/designs/src/ibex/*.v]

# Elaborate design
elaborate ibex_core
current_design ibex_core
link

# Apply constraints
source ${design_dir}/designs/sky130hd/ibex/constraint.sdc

# Compile
compile_ultra

# Reports
report_timing -max_paths 5
report_area

# Write outputs
write -format verilog -hierarchy -output ${design_dir}/result/syn/data/ibex_core.syn.v
write_sdc ${design_dir}/result/syn/data/ibex_core.syn.sdc
